# ReelForge

> Local tool that turns a voice recording and one episode.yaml into finished 1080×1920 vertical explainer videos (TikTok, Reels, Shorts): 21 animated components timed to spoken words, English and Arabic (right-to-left) word-by-word captions, sound effects, mastered audio and platform-ready MP4s. AI agents drive it through the `reelforge mcp` server.

## For agents
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): workflow, episode.yaml essentials, layout rules, quality checklist, code guide
- [MCP setup for every client](docs/manual/15-ai-agents.md): Claude Code/Desktop, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Windsurf, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cline

## Reference
- [Authoring guide](docs/authoring.md): spec, time expressions, placement, animation, validation rules
- [Component reference](docs/components.md): every component's props and defaults
- [Command line](docs/manual/11-cli.md)
- [JSON Schema](schema/episode.schema.json): `reelforge schema` writes it

## Examples
- [examples/season1](examples/season1): the English "System Design" series (9 episodes)
- [examples/season1-arabic](examples/season1-arabic): the same series in Arabic with English terms
